other_conditions: Applicant must be located within the National Capital Territory of Delhi
Investment in plant, machinery and equipment must not exceed the ceiling prescribed for small‑scale units by the Central Government
Applicant must furnish a surety/security of one Government servant (employee of GNCTD, its autonomous bodies or Central Government working in Delhi)
For units in non‑conforming areas, a No Objection Certificate from the High Power Committee and a Municipal Corporation License (MCL) are required
For professional/commercial activities, a Registration Certificate from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) is required
benefits_summary: Loan up to ₹3,00,000 with a 15% subsidy on project cost (capped at ₹7,500 per entrepreneur).
documents_required: Surety/security document of one Government servant
No Objection Certificate from the High Power Committee (for non‑conforming areas)
Registration Certificate from MCD (for trade activities)
